created_for: priority10 real breath VOC literature panels

curation_policy.scope: Human breath, exhaled alveolar gas, ventilator exhalate, or exhaled breath condensate studies in published literature or cited public breath repositories.
curation_policy.quantified_rule: Numerical log2 fold changes are calculated only from ratios explicitly reported in the cited source.
curation_policy.directional_rule: When a cited source reports only increased/decreased direction for an atlas VOC, measured_log2fc uses conservative placeholder values of +0.6 for increased and -0.4 for decreased, and voc_evidence marks evidence as directional_only.
curation_policy.null_or_mixed_rule: Numerical values from studies reporting no statistically significant disease/control separation are retained only when explicitly published and evidence is marked mixed.

healthy_baseline.title: A study of 9 common breath VOCs in 504 healthy subjects using PTR-TOF-MS
healthy_baseline.role: Healthy breath context for atlas VOCs; disease fold changes below use each cited study's own comparator when available.
